title: The Functional Systems of Generative Collapse Dynamics: UMCP, RCFT, and ULRC as Measurement, Discovery, and Language Preservation — A Consolidated Thesis of Functional Operation and Domain Ingress
source_native_claims: UMCP measures, RCFT explores, and ULRC preserves language; the tiers govern what may be preserved, executed, translated, or changed, while the functional systems govern what kind of work is being performed.
The consolidated discipline is: freeze before judgment, explore before canon, and translate without drift.
